## Rule

**Corpus-proven 200,000/200,000 (2026-06-06).** Two vertical wall groups of `2`s: one at col 0
(left), one at col W−1 (right) — contiguous, **equal heights** (4–6 rows), vertical offset
delta = startR − startL ∈ ±[6..18] (right group can be ABOVE the left one). Seeds (`8`s) appear
in **exactly one** group's rows, ≤1 per row, never at col 0, never on a wall, ≥1 per grid.

Per seeded row: fill strictly between wall and seed with `8`, seed becomes `4`. The row at the
**same relative offset in the other group** gets a full-width `8` fill — cols 1..W−1 for a
left-group row, cols 0..W−2 for a right-group row (everything except that row's wall cell).

Corpus facts that license the build (2026-06-06 sweep, `t148_corpus_analysis.py`):
grids 16×8..24×12 (CROP-CONTRACT: 24×12 canvas exact); colors in = {0,2,8}, out += {4};
always exactly 1 left + 1 right group; right wall always at col W−1, one `2` per wall row;
groups never touch row 0 or the last row (mirror gather indices always in-range, no Clip);
no cross-seeded mirror pairs (seeds in one group only).

## Algorithm sketch

```python
def solve(g):
    out = g.copy(); is2, is8 = g == 2, g == 8
    left = where(is2[:, 0]); right = where(is2.any(1) & ~is2[:, 0])
    for r in seeded_rows:                 # rows with an 8
        sc = seed_col(r); out[r, sc] = 4
        if r in left:   out[r, 1:sc] = 8;       out[right.start + (r - left.start), :W-1] = 8
        else:           out[r, sc+1:W-1] = 8;   out[left.start + (r - right.start), 1:] = 8
    return out
```
Full reference: `solve()` in `task148/prototypes/build_task148_v5_marginals.py`.

### Sub-3,000 impossibility (2026-06-06, after owner request to push below 3,000/1,500)

For STATIC graphs `_score_v2` == Kaggle exactly (§39 MECHANISM, 30+ landings) — there is no
pricing gap to probe; the documented under-counting exploits (symbolic dims, Compress-zero,
`ConstantOfShape(Shape(x))` wrappers, init→Constant) are owner-banned in
`scoring_internals.md` A.2 ("ethical play only") AND dead under the current grader
(strict shape inference + real-input `max(static, observed)`; the dynamic family REPRICES UP
37×–78×, §39 GAP-LEDGER). So the bound is architectural:

**Lemma 1 (carrier ≥ 900 B).** The output op must emit [1,10,30,30]; its only non-initializer
input is the cost. Every 2-operand factorization with sub-900 inputs
(A[·,·,30,1] op B[·,·,1,30]) fails on a specific channel:
- `Equal`: ch8 fill — two seeded rows with different seed cols force colval[w] to equal two
  distinct rowvals on overlapping column prefixes (contradiction).
- `Mul`-sign (>0 decode): handles ch2's two-rectangle union, but ch4 seeds at per-row varying
  columns need >2 sign-rectangles.
- `Add/Sub`-threshold: per-channel firing sets must be nested across rows (staircase); ch2's
  two wall columns with disjoint row sets violate it (proven: no (a,b) thresholds exist).
- `And/Or`: per-channel rank-1 rectangles only.
- `Less/Greater`: nested half-line sets; same ch2 violation.
- `Conv`-as-output: linear in carrier channels ⇒ needs ≥2-channel F16/F32 quadratic-feature
  carrier ([1,2,24,12] F16 + Mul + Concat = 2,304+ > 900-path; measured).
Hence a true ≥[1,1,30,30] 1-byte carrier (900 B) into the output op is forced.

**Lemma 2 (canvas production ≥ ~1,728 B).** The carrier needs per-cell {bg, wall, seed,
sentinel} + fill. Cheapest whole-input read = 1×1 negpad Conv (1,152 F32) + Cast U8 (288) +
fill-Where (288) = 1,728; the conv-free vector reconstruction is 3,816 (measured, see above).

**Lemma 3 (fill + machinery ≥ ~1,700 B).** Fill needs a per-cell 2-threshold test: csub+Less
= 576 minimum (single-op interval alternatives all materialize ≥1 extra plane). Row reads
(360), classes (120), delta+mirror (325 — GatherElements indices are spec-forced INT32 ≥120),
bounds (275), slices (48) — each verified against ≥1 cheaper-looking alternative that
measured worse.

Floor = 900 + 1,728 + ~1,700 ≈ **4.3–4.4k**; v10 = 4,461 (mem 4,332 + params 129).
**Sub-3,000 is not reachable honestly-static for this rule**; the next real LB win from this
session's techniques is spreading the free-output-Equal tail to other Equal-tail tasks
(`Onnx_Advanced/.update/2026-06-06_task148_freeout_equal_einsum3_i8lanes.md`).

## Don't-do log

- **Don't gather with F16/INT8 indices** — GatherElements indices are INT32/INT64 only
  (ONNX spec); the [1,30] INT32 cast (120B) is unavoidable. INT8 idx arithmetic IS fine.
- **Don't put `Add`/`Sub`/`Mul` on U8/INT8 at opset 13** — integer-narrow arithmetic needs
  **opset 14** (v8 build failed shape inference at 13; bumping fixed it; ORT runs 14 fine).
- **Don't compute canvas channels from vectors instead of the 1×1 negpad Conv** — priced
  ~2.2–2.7k vs Conv+Cast 1,440 (wall/seed Equal planes + masks + active-plane reconstruction
  all cost [1,1,24,12]-class tensors).
- **Don't try sparse inits, GridSample, dynamic Pad/Mod shifts** — banned/taxed/crash-class
  (§14z family, #44 GridSample 2HW tax, §GRADER-GAP crash class on dynamic buffer reuse).
- **Don't drop the `eight`-Where before the Pad** — padding the fill into the canvas at 30×30
  costs 900B (fill plane at 30×30) vs 288B (Where at 24×12 pre-pad).
- **Don't worry about #45 packing here** — ≤3 BOOL plane consumers, α≈0 ⇒ packing strictly
  loses (pack+unpack outputs both count).
- 2026-05-19 (BIG_RSUM_a): no equal-fold/add-chain/mul-ones patterns in the old LIVE; Conv
  with all-ones kernel not cheaply replaceable in that graph (superseded by the rewrite).
